items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday at Houston.
items.why: Back tightness after Week 1 hits; self-reported expectation to play.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; start if active as usual QB1.

items.text: Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Kamara=Kendre Miller; others including Lane=Bateman.
items.why: Precise fallout from W1 injuries and IR moves.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year—scary history. DNP Wednesday possible.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach positive but prior knee issues.
items.implication: Have Mayer ready; Bowers high upside if active but monitor snap share.

items.text: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling had surgery to repair deltoid rupture/ankle; expected back late Nov/early Dec (~10 weeks).
items.why: Opted for surgery on deltoid rupture for full recovery.
items.implication: Opens targets for Deebo Samuel and others in SF WR room.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans to place on IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; streamer/matchup play vs ARI.

items.text: Vikings placed RB Jordan Mason on IR with thumb fracture (surgery for small fracture); expected back after ~4 weeks. Signed DeeJay Dallas.
items.why: Thumb fracture fixed surgically; short-term IR.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 offensive snaps in specialized package (jet, screens, decoy); zero routes past LOS. Jags intent clear with Meyers extension and retaining BTJ/Washington.
items.why: Offseason actions/words confirmed limited offensive role.
items.implication: Not a reliable fantasy WR yet; more DB/gadget.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid SF WR injuries (Stribling out long-term).
items.why: Role expansion with Stribling surgery/IR path; proven producer.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) day-to-day/DNP risk for Week 2; ETR flags Tre Harris as primary beneficiary.
items.why: Rib injury from W1; Harbaugh day-to-day, possible contusion.
items.implication: Monitor practice; stash Harris if McConkey limited/out.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving role as expected in new offense.
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS; elite opportunity share.
items.opportunity: Near every-down back with receiving work.

items.text: With Alvin Kamara (knee) out, Travis Etienne did not dominate: snaps 53/26/15 (Miller/Donaldson), routes 24/7/5, opps 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne RB2 but not locked every-down; Miller handcuff/upside.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after MCL tear surgery; placed on IR. Promoted WR KhaDarel Hodge, signed TE Jack Stoll.
items.implication: TE depth thin; Kittle primary if healthy.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game—buy-low opportunity on volume.
items.why: High expected points indicate opportunity; efficiency/game script failed.
items.implication: Hold/buy; WR2/3 upside with Lions volume.

items.text: ETR Rest of Season Top-150 rankings live after Week 1 usage lessons (Walker workhorse, Hunter limited, etc.); trade calculator also up. Sizable changes based on opportunity.
items.implication: Reassess holds/trades with fresh opportunity data.
